title: Vault vulnerable to ACL deny bypass via case-variant auth method user and group names (CVE-2026-128100)
description: Vault Community Edition and Vault Enterprise contained a vulnerability where ACL deny rules were not applied to case variants of user and group names in certain auth methods. This could allow an authenticated user with delegated permissions to modify protected users or groups, potentially leading to privilege escalation. The issue is fixed in Vault Community Edition 2.2.2 and Vault Enterprise 2.2.2, 1.21.14, and 1.19.25.
